scope: post-hoc 192-question paired warm-process implementation timing; no GT or quality decision
rank_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array [seed,purpose,task,qid,group_id,image_sha256], SHA256 hexadecimal lexicographic ascending
partition: within each task rank its 64 measured identities with purpose=partition and split consecutively into four blocks of 16
within_block: rank the 48 combined task identities by purpose=block-N and the same encoding
warmup: first DocVQA_VAL warmup group in the already-frozen E4 latency source cohort; identical warmup for every process; exclude from all measured groups
limits: implementation comparison only; no quality or universal claim
